title: (RHBA-2020:3472) s390utils bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary:
An update for s390utils is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.6
Extended Update Support.
portal_synopsis: s390utils bug fix and enhancement update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM z Systems - Extended Update Support|7.6|s390x
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be
used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* RHEL7.6 - zipl/libc: Fix potential buffer overflow in printf
(s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#1834807)
